title: Pajjoto
text: Kati lokasmiṃ pajjotā || yehi loko pakāsati. || bhavantaṃ puṭṭhum āgamma || kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayan ti || || Cattāro loke pajjotā || pañcam-etthana vijjati || divā tapati ādicco || rattim ābhāti candimā || || atha aggi divārattiṃ || tattha tattha pabhāsati || sambuddho tapataṃ seṭṭho || esā ābhā anuttarā ti || ||
